title: Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development (combined position)
description:
Professor of Shared Decision-making and Professional Development 

A combined position as Professor (50%) and as Research Director (50%) is vacant at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and at the Centre for Shared Decision Making, Lillebaelt Hospital, Vejle, respectively.

The position is offered for five years, with the possibility of extension.

The academic positionThe professor will advance research into shared decision-making (SDM) and the involvement of patients and their relatives, as well as the professional development required to integrate these approaches into clinical practice. The professor will be part of the management team at the joint centre at Lillebælt Hospital and will foster coherence between research, education and implementation. The professor will be appointed at the Department of Regional Health Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU. The academic field combines SDM with professional development for healthcare professionals. Interdisciplinary research and collaboration across clinical settings are expected and central to the position.

Research leadership and responsibilitiesAt Lillebaelt Hospital, the professor/appointee will serve as Research Director. Together with the Centre Director, the Research Director forms the joint center leadership. The Research Director has line management responsibility for academic staff and overall scientific and strategic responsibility for research activities associated with the Center for Shared Decision Making (CFFB) and the Center for Involvement of Relatives (CEPI). The two leadership roles work closely together on the development of the centers.

The professor is expected responsible for:

  • Strategic Research Leadership and Centre ManagementThe position as professor includes overall scientific and strategic responsibility for the research units affiliated with both CFFB and CEPI as well as their interdisciplinary research group. This includes line management and academic leadership of researchers, ensuring the stable operation of the centers, and maintaining strategic oversight of the centers’ grant portfolio and funding pipeline.

  • Fundraising and External Research FundingThe professor is expected to secure substantial external research funding from national and international funding bodies to ensure the long-term sustainability and development of the centers’ research activities.

  • Practice-Oriented Empirical ResearchThe professor is expected to develop and lead empirical research SDM projects with a particular focus on the perspectives of patients, relatives, and healthcare professionals within different diseases, specialties and healthcare settings, while contributing to the advancement of qualitative and applied research methodologies such as action research.

  • Development of Educational Resources, Curriculum Design, and Educational TransformationThe position requires designing and developing practical educational tools and implementation resources — e.g., learning materials — that support healthcare professionals’ learning and continuing professional development in clinical practice performing SDM.

  • Teaching, lecturing, supervising and disseminating knowledgeThe professor should teach and mentor postdocs, PhD students, and undergraduate students. Participation in assessment work is part of the position. Additionally, profiling this research area in the public eye will be an important task.

Research activity, network and collaborationThe candidate is expected to demonstrate prior experience with research activities in terms of networks and collaborations. The professor is expected to increase research activity at the research unit and to expand collaboration with other researchers at hospitals in the Region of Southern Denmark, at SDU, the rest of Denmark and internationally.

The position as Research Director at the Centre for Shared Decision Making (CFFB)The Professorship in Shared Decision-making and Professional Development at the Center for Shared Decision Making, Vejle, Denmark, is established to support the continued implementation of Lillebaelt Hospital’s research strategy and the hospital’s overarching commitment to placing the patient at the center of care.

Over the past decade, the Center has conducted research on evidence-based approaches to SDM and has demonstrated that SDM is associated with high patient satisfaction and improved adherence to agreed treatment plans. The professorship will build on this strong research foundation by advancing knowledge on the implementation of SDM and the continuing professional development of healthcare professionals. International research consistently shows that achieving sustained and authentic SDM practice in everyday clinical care remains a significant implementation challenge. Changing professional practices and departmental cultures requires more than time-limited projects or implementation initiatives. Sustainable integration of SDM depends on ongoing and continuous competence development that supports long-term changes in clinical practice.

This professorship is positioned at the intersection of health sciences research, implementation in clinical practice, and professional development through applied educational research. The core purpose of the position is to strengthen and transform the healthcare system’s capacity for meaningful patient and family involvement through SDM.

The professorship requires strategic research leadership from a scholar with extensive expertise in lifelong learning, learning theory, curriculum theory, and action research, and with the ability to translate this knowledge into continuing professional development for healthcare professionals. The professor is expected to lead the national and international research agenda on how SDM can be integrated meaningfully and sustainably into routine clinical practice, to achieve enduring behavioral change among healthcare professionals.

QualificationsThe required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a PhD or equivalent post-graduate research qualification and demonstrate scientific achievements at a level appropriate for appointment as Professor.

  • The position calls for expertise in educational science as applied to the professional development of healthcare staff or other types of welfare staff, together with substantial knowledge of and research contributions to SDM.

  • The applicant should be able to demonstrate experience of teaching and lecturing at university and postgraduate level, as well as experience as principal supervisor on PhD projects and academic assessment work, as evidenced by the teaching portfolio.

  • Danish language skills are not required at the time of appointment, but must be mastered at proficiency level C1, at the Common European Framework of References for Languages within the first 2 years of employment.

The ideal candidate preferably demonstrates:

  • The candidate should demonstrate experience with leadership capacity with the ability to lead research teams, drive cultural change, and contribute strategically to the development of the centers.

  • The candidate holds experience in research management, interdisciplinary collaboration, and attraction of external funding for professional development and/or SDM-oriented activities will be considered an advantage.

  • The candidate preferably demonstrates experience with practice-oriented empirical research. Research that is aimed at both an international research community, and ideally also at the target group of professionals in Denmark; therefore, publications and outputs are welcome to be in Danish – whether in the form of books, leaflets, journal publications or other material designed to ensure that both professionals undertaking continuing professional development in Denmark and students on undergraduate program are best supported and thereby ensuring impact.

  • The candidate has prior experience with developing, implementing, and/or evaluating educational programs, frameworks, and curricula for continuing professional development, preferably in terms of SDM-related competencies. Experience of developing and evaluating continuing professional education in clinical settings is valued.

  • The preferred candidate can motivate and supervise, has proven research management skills, good interpersonal skills in charge of a research group, and has a clear vision for how to further strengthen the research unit at CFFB as strong interpersonal and collaborative skills are essential.

  • The successful applicant will have documented experience of leading research and researchers, obtain external funding and work across disciplines and organizations.

EmployersCFFB is a national knowledge and competence center based at Lillebaelt Hospital. Since 2014, it has researched SDM and since 2019 developed approaches for implementation in clinical practice. CEPI works to strengthen meaningful involvement of relatives. The centers retain their distinct areas of responsibility while collaborating closely on research and practice. Lillebaelt Hospital provides somatic and mental healthcare across sites in Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart. Patient and family involvement is central to their approach to care.

SDU's Department of Regional Health Research links research and education with hospitals and clinical environments across the Region of Southern Denmark. The Department of Regional Health Research supports research in relation to the person as a whole, the good life and the more common diseases, makes out a platform for scientists and educators and builds a bridge between University of Southern Denmark, The Region of Southern Denmark, the hospitals in the region and the patient. The department focuses on the continuity of patient care across sectors, hospitals, and specialist fields.

Reference The professor and research director will refer to the hospital management regarding matters concerning the management of the centres, and to the Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, Mikkel Brabrand, in matters regarding the professorship.

Contact informationFurther information concerning the position can be obtained by contacting:

  • The Research Coordinator at Lillebælt Hospital, Jonna Skov Madsen, Jonna.Skov.Madsen@rsyd.dk, +45 30507825

  • The Director of the Centre, Karina Olling, Karina.Olling@rsyd.dk, +45 51518696

  • The Head of the Department of Regional Health Research, SDU, Mikkel Brabrand, mbrabrand@health.sdu.dk, +45 93534980

Salary and terms of employmentThe successful applicant for the professor position will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Professor is salaried in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and on terms corresponding to salary grade 37 of the Danish state salary system. Additional qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Center for Shared Decision Making (Center for Fælles Beslutningstagning), Beriderbakken 4, 7100 Vejle, Denmark.

ApplicationOnly applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • An application

  • A detailed CV

  • Degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma or equivalent)

  • A complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position (please notice that one pdf file must be attached for each publication)

  • It is permitted to merge the 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications into a single PDF file due to upload constraints.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • Track record in obtaining research funding

  • National and international research collaboration and collaborations with researchers in other disciplines and sectors

  • A research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. Incomplete applications with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

The application deadline is 11 November 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

AssessmentShortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

title: MHPSS Advisor
description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
description:
Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

  • Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:

Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

  • Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:

Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

  • Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
  • Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
  • International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
  • Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program.

  1. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment.
  2. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
  3. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

“For me, the biggest value being part of the Gram Equipment Graduate Program has been the people I have worked with along the way and the understanding I have gained of how the different parts of the organization come together.”Tommy Bui (ENG Integrated Design - SDU) - Project Manager at Gram Equipment

“The Graduate program gave me a strong network across the entire company and useful insights into many of our internal processes.” / “Contributing to such a significant change as a graduate was both empowering and a clear example of how my work could make a meaningful difference.”Luciana Apachitei (ENG in Global Business Engineering - VIA University College) - Engineering Excellence Project Manager "At Gram Equipment, I have shaped the company's direction and the projects related to it. I have had the chance to choose the projects that interested me. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." -Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Store Design Associate
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Associate Store Designer supports our franchise expansion from an own HQ point of view by delivering high-quality, on-brand store designs through structured processes and strong governance. The role ensures all projects meet global design standards, timelines, and approval requirements, while maintaining full documentation and alignment between design intent and final build.

The job is a full-time role. We expect the start date to be 1st of December.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee 3rd party designers and ensure design packages aligned with Design Manual and Design Hardgates.

  • Review and acknowledge project kick-offs.

  • Maintain design timelines and update project trackers.

  • Safeguard design compliance with design manuals, materials, and concept standards.

  • Manage design documentation to internal platforms.

  • Support external designers and franchise partners to ensure correct implementation.

  • Assist with design audits and ensure alignment between design and final store outcome.

  • Contribute to maintaining and improving design manuals, tools, and processes.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An early-career professional ready to apply your developing design and project management skills to franchise store execution.

  • Someone who takes ownership of defined tasks and delivers accurately, on time, and in line with global standards.

  • Comfortable handling straightforward design and coordination challenges independently, and confident escalating more complex issues when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Developing design and project management skills, with an eye for detail and brand consistency.

  • A structured approach to documentation, timelines, and tracking.

  • The ability to collaborate with external designers and franchise partners across markets.

OUR BENEFITS

We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

  • Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

  • Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

  • At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

  • Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

  • As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

description:
Work tasks: We are looking for an experienced Electronics Repair Engineer to join our established service center, specializing in component-level diagnostics and repairs. We need a technically minded professional who understands electronic circuits, can independently troubleshoot faults, and is comfortable working with unfamiliar equipment. Responsibilities Diagnose and repair electronic circuit boards at component level. Repair computers, laptops, smartphones, TVs, audio equipment, amplifiers, power supplies, and household electronics. Work with industrial, automotive, motorcycle, and specialized electronics. Repair professional audio, DJ, and stage lighting equipment. Assess the technical feasibility and cost-effectiveness of repairs. Receive equipment, communicate with customers, and agree on repair costs and deadlines. Independently manage repair orders from intake to completion and handover.

We offer: Compensation of 40% of successfully completed repair work.Earnings based on skills, efficiency, and completed repair volume. Fully equipped workshop with an existing flow of repair orders. Diverse technical challenges and independence in daily work. Opportunities for professional development.

Other requirements: Requirements:Practical experience in component-level electronics repair. Good understanding of analog and digital electronics. Ability to read circuit diagrams and technical documentation. Confident use of multimeters, oscilloscopes, and soldering equipment. SMD soldering skills. Independent problem-solving, responsibility, attention to detail, and technical thinking. Good customer communication skills. Estonian language proficiency. Russian is an advantage. A formal degree or technical diploma is not required. Practical skills, experience, and the ability to solve real technical problems matter most. Additional Advantages Experience repairing automotive electronic modules (ECUs, instrument clusters, amplifiers). Knowledge of industrial electronics and automation. BGA rework skills. Experience with specialized or unusual electronic equipment.

Option to work from home: No

Töö eeldab head plekitööoskust, tehnilist taiplikkust, täpsust ja loomingulist lähenemist. Oluline on oskus valmistada keredetaile ka olukorras, kus valmis varuosi ei ole saadaval.

Kui sulle meeldib oma kätega midagi erilist luua, hindad häid tööriistu ja tahad näha oma töö üle uhkust tundmist väärt tulemust, siis meie juures on sul selleks kõik võimalused!

Muud nõuded: Millist inimest oma meeskonda ootame?Täpset ja põhjalikku – hindad kvaliteeti, pöörad tähelepanu detailidele ja tunned uhkust oma töö üle. Tehniliselt taiplikku ja leidlikku – oskad iseseisvalt mõelda, probleeme lahendada ja vajadusel nutikaid lahendusi välja töötada. Kannatlikku ja järjekindlat – mõistad, et kvaliteetne taastamistöö nõuab aega, pühendumist ja täpsust. Iseseisvat ja vastutustundlikku – oskad oma tööd planeerida, võtad vastutuse tulemuse eest ja pead kokkulepetest kinni. Õpihimulist ja arenemissooviga – tunned huvi uute töövõtete vastu ja soovid oma meisterlikkust pidevalt täiendada. Positiivset ja meeskonnahingega – oled sõbralik, koostööaldis ja aitad kaasa heale töökeskkonnale. Kõige olulisem on, et sul oleks tõeline huvi autode taastamise ja plekitöö vastu, head käelised oskused ning soov teha tööd, mille üle saad ise uhkust tunda.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Personaalset töökohta.• Tööriideid ja töövahendeid. • Tervisekindlustust. • Tööd ühes vahetuses (õhtu- ja öövahetused puuduvad, kuid võib esineda ületunde). • Sõbralikku ja professionaalset kollektiivi. • Kohapealset tööd (kaugtöö võimalus puudub). • Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt kandidaadi teadmistele ja kogemustele. • Arenguvõimalusi ning töötasu kasvu koos professionaalse arenguga. • Kontorit Lasnamäel. • Töötasu on kokkuleppel ja sõltub kandidaadi kvalifikatsioonist. • Pakume võimalust omandada teadmisi laevaseadmete, GMDSS-süsteemide ja satelliitsidesüsteemide paigaldamise ning hooldamise valdkonnas.

Muud nõuded: • Haridus elektroonika, telekommunikatsiooni või mereinseneri erialal või samaväärne töökogemus.• Vähemalt 2-aastane töökogemus navigatsiooni- ja raadiosidesüsteemide ning nõrkvoolusüsteemidega. • Head teadmised GMDSS-, ECDIS-, radari-, AIS-, GPS- ja VDR-süsteemidest. • Kehtiv GOC või ROC sertifikaat (eeliseks). • Oskus iseseisvalt diagnoosida ja lahendada tehnilisi probleeme. • Arusaam elektrivoolust ja pingest, alalis- ja vahelduvvoolust ning ühe- ja kolmefaasilistest toitesüsteemidest. • Valmidus töölähetusteks Eestis ja välismaal. • Hea kliendisuhtlemisoskus. • Arusaam ärikirjavahetuse põhimõtetest. • Inglise keele oskus; teiste võõrkeelte oskus tuleb kasuks. • Viisakus, professionaalsus ja soov areneda. • Valmidus õppida ning omandada uusi oskusi. • B-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu. • Oleme valmis välja õpetama motiveeritud kandidaadi, kellel on algteadmised raadionavigatsioonist ja nõrkvooluelektrist.

title: Rasketehnika ja erilahenduste tehnik
description:
Tööülesanded: Kõiki tehnilisi töid ei saa teha hooldusjuhendi järgi. Mõnikord tuleb sobiv lahendus ise välja mõelda, valmistada ja tööle panna.Kui sulle meeldib lisaks remondile ehitada, kohandada ning lahendada tehnilisi ülesandeid, millele valmis vastust alati olemas ei ole, võib Gravenori Pärnu esindus olla just sinu järgmine töökoht. Gravenori Pärnu esinduses tegeleme lisaks tehnika hooldusele ja remondile suuremate ümberehituste, pealisehituste ning kliendi vajadustele loodud erilahendustega. Ühel päeval võib töös olla tõstuki või rasketehnika remont, järgmisel hüdraulika- või elektrisüsteemi ümberehitus ning seejärel suurem projekt, kus masinale tuleb sobiv lahendus valmistada, paigaldada ja tööle seadistada. Töö hõlmab sõltuvalt projektist: - rasketehnika, tõste- ja laotehnika remonti; - mehaanika-, hüdraulika- ja elektritöid; - masinate ning seadmete ümberehitamist; - pealisehituste ja lisaseadmete paigaldamist; - rikete diagnoosimist ja tehniliste lahenduste leidmist; - suuremate eriprojektide teostamist algusest lõpuni. Siin ei ole iga tööpäev ühesugune ning alati ei piisa ainult detaili väljavahetamisest. Oluline on oskus kaasa mõelda, leida töötav lahendus ja viia alustatud töö lõpuni.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Mitmekülgset tööd erinevate masinate ja projektidega.- Võimalust osaleda suuremates ümberehitustes ja erilahenduste loomises. - Kaasaegseid töövahendeid ja süsteemset töökorraldust - Kogenud meeskonna tuge. - Tööks vajalikke ja sinu arengusoovidele vastavaid koolitusi. - Võimalust kasutada ning edasi arendada oma tehnilisi oskusi. - Töötasu alates 2300 € bruto, sõltuvalt kogemusest ja oskustest. - Võimalust töötada uutmoodi, süsteemselt üles ehitatud ja pidevalt arenevas tehnikateeninduses.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui sul on tehniline taip, varasem kogemus masinate või seadmete remondiga ning soov teha midagi enamat kui tavapärased hooldustööd. Kasuks tuleb kogemus mehaanika, hüdraulika, elektri, keevituse või diagnostikaga. Kõike ei pea kohe oskama – tähtis on praktiline mõtlemine, õppimisvõime ja huvi keerukamate tehniliste tööde vastu.

title: Hooldustehnik
description:
Tööülesanded: Kulunud voolik, lõtk liigendites või ebatavaline heli - hea hooldustehnik märkab asju, millest võib hiljem saada suurem probleem. Ta tunneb masina vastu huvi ja tahab, et tehtud töö järel saaks sellele kindel olla. Kui selline suhtumine iseloomustab ka sind, tule Gravenori meeskonda! Otsime Tallinna esindusse hooldustehnikut. Sinu peamine töö on tõstukite, laotehnika ja teiste tõsteseadmete hooldamine ning mehaaniliste ja hüdrauliliste sõlmede remont. Töötad nii meie töökojas kui ka klientide juures. Sinu tööülesanded on: - Masinate korraline hooldus ja tehnilise seisukorra kontroll. - Õlide, filtrite, vedelike ja kuluvosade vahetamine. - Mastide, kettide, liigendite ja teiste liikuvate osade kontroll, määrimine ning reguleerimine. - Pidurite, roolisüsteemide ja veermiku hooldus ning remont. - Hüdraulikavoolikute, ühenduste ja silindrite kontroll ning remont. - Avastatud puuduste ja tehtud tööde dokumenteerimine. - Masina töö ja ohutuse kontroll pärast hooldust või remonti.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Töötasu alates 2500 € bruto, lähtudes sinu oskustest ja kogemustest.- Tööd mitmete premium-brändide tehnikaga ning võimalust arendada oma oskusi erinevate masinate ja tehniliste lahendustega töötades. - Vaheldusrikast tööd erinevate masinatega nii töökojas kui ka klientide juures. - Selget töökorraldust ja uudset digitaalset lahendust, mis annab sulle tööülesanded ja vajaliku info mugavalt kätte ning teeb tehtud tööde märkimise lihtsaks. - Kogenud meeskonna tuge - saad nõu küsida ja keerulisemaid töid koos lahendada. - Võimalust arendada oma oskusi hoolduse, mehaanika ja hüdraulika valdkonnas. - Võimalust kaasa rääkida töökorralduse ja töövõtete parandamisel. Hindame sinu praktilisi tähelepanekuid ja ettepanekuid.

Muud nõuded: Ootame praktilise mõtlemisega inimest, kes tunneb tööriistu, saab aru masinate ehitusest ja teeb oma tööd hoolikalt.Kasuks tuleb varasem kogemus tõstukite, põllumajandus-, ehitus- või rasketehnika hooldamisel ja remontimisel. Oluline on mehaanika ja hüdraulika tundmine, oskus hinnata detailide seisukorda ning soov oma teadmisi täiendada. Ootame sinult: - Tehnilist taipu ja oskust leida praktilisi lahendusi. - Hoolikust ning vastutust oma töö kvaliteedi eest. - Valmisolekut töötada iseseisvalt ja teha koostööd meeskonnaga. - Oskust märgata puudusi ja anda neist selgelt teada. - Vähemalt B-kategooria juhiluba. Kõiki meie juures teenindatavaid masinaid ei pea sa esimesest päevast tundma - oluline on hea tehniline põhi ja tahtmine õppida.

Tähtajatu tööleping ehitusfirmas

Tööülesanded: Otsime iseseisvat müürsepp-üldehitajat, kes loeb tööjooniseid ja konstruktsiooniprojekti, teab, miks lahendus on just selline, ja vastutab oma töö kvaliteedi eest kuni üleandmiseni. Töö katab kogu hoone kandekonstruktsioonist kuni sise- ja eriosadeni, seega on vaja laia oskusteavet ja täpset käsi.Müüritööd Kandvate seinte ladumine ja armeerimine konstruktsiooniprojekti järgi. Ehitaja tagab seinte sirguse, loodi ja tasapinnalisuse lubatud hälvete piires ning avade, šahtide ja läbiviikude täpse asukoha ja mõõdud. Müüritise täisvalud ja lintvundamendiga seotud tööd. Siia kuulub sarruse paigutus, betooni täitmine ja tihendamine nii, et valu jääks tühimiketa ja oleks projektikohane. Silluste ehitus sarrusplokist: paigaldus, armeerimine, valamine ja ajutine toestus. Ehitaja peab arvestama tugipindade, koormuste ja toestuse eemaldamise ajaga. Üldehitustööd Armeerimis- ja betoonitööd vundamentides ja nendega seotud konstruktsioonides. Töö tehakse jooniste järgi, jälgides kaitsekihte, sarruse jätkupikkusi ja betooni hooldust. Katuse ja välisseinte soojustus ning tuule- ja aurutõkke paigaldus. Ehitaja tagab sõlmede ja liitekohtade õhupidavuse ning külmasildade vältimise. Fassaadi aluskarkassi ja fassaadikatte paigaldus. Töö eeldab täpset mõõdistamist ning kinnitussammu ja tuulutuspilu järgimist vastavalt tootja ja projekti nõuetele. Avatäidete paigaldus: Uksed paigaldab ehitaja ise. Akende puhul valmistab ehitaja ette avad ning teeb paigaldussõlme tihenduse ja liitumise seina soojustuse ja tõketega. Aknad paigaldab tootja meeskond. Vaheseinte ehitus: karkass, soojustus ja kipsplaat. Ehitaja arvestab heli- ja tuleohutusnõuetega ning eriosade läbiviikude ja kinnituste asukohtadega. Eriosade paigaldustööd Veetorustiku, kütte- ja jahutustorustiku ning ventilatsioonitorustiku paigaldus eriosade projektide järgi. Ehitaja hoiab kalded, kinnitused ja isolatsiooni korras ning koordineerib tööd teiste osapooltega. Survekatsete läbiviimine ja tulemuste fikseerimine protokollis. Lisaks ootame Kaetud tööde ettevalmistamist ülevaatuseks ja osalemist nende dokumenteerimisel. Oma töö kvaliteedi kontrolli enne järgmise etapi algust. Võimet märgata jooniste ebakõlasid ja anda neist objektijuhile õigeaegselt teada.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tööriided ja isikukaitsevahendidKvaliteetsed tööriistad Kasvule ja efektiivsusele orienteeritud meeskond Kaasamõtlemist väärtustav töökeskkond Ettevõttesisesed arenguvõimalused

Muud nõuded: Ausus.Koostöövalmidus. Mõtlemisvõime.

title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.Salary and benefits: Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting) Comprehensive private occupational health care Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers Holiday bonus pay Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process: Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!Please note:(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

title: Ajoneuvoasentaja
description: Etsimme asiakkaallemme Hyötyajoneuvoasentajaa pidempään työsuhteeseen.Yritys on erikoistunut kuljetuskaluston huoltoihin ja korjauksiin, kattaen sekä raskaan että hieman kevyemmän kaluston. Yritys toimii myös valtuutettuna huoltokorjaamona. Yrityksessä työskentelee useampi huolto- ja korjaamotoiminnan ammattilainen ja sillä on jo kymmenien vuosien kokemus vastata asiakkaiden tarpeisiin.Tehtävästä:Työskentelet hyötyajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä. Vastuullasi on raskaankaluston huollot ja korjaukset. Työtehtävät ovat joko huolto-ohjelman mukaisesti tehtäviä töitä tai tehtävät voivat olla äkillisiä, kuljetuskaluston vikoihin pohjautuvia korjauksia. Työ on toisinaan fyysisesti raskasta ja nopeatempoista. Työ on päivätyötä.Odotamme:Valittavalta henkilöltä edellytetään työtehtäviin liittyvää koulutusta ja/tai aiempaa kokemusta raskaan kaluston huolto- ja korjaustehtävistä. Lisäksi valitulta henkilöltä toivotaan löytyvän osaamista myös testereiden käytöstä tai yleisesti vianhausta tai vikakoodien tulkinnasta. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää omatoimisuutta, paineensietokykyä, vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä sekä joustavaa asennetta.Tarjoamme:Mahdollisuuden työskennellä hyvässä työporukassa ja pitkät perinteet omaavassa yrityksessä. Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työn, osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen sekä ympärillesi mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön.Työsuhteessa noudatetaan Autoalan kaupan ja korjaamotoiminnan työehtosopimusta.Haku:Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa! Jätäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian.Täytäthän hakemuksen ensisijaisesti kotisivuillamme www.henkilostoliiga.fi [http://www.henkilostoliiga.fi]Valitettavasti emme pysty tietoturvasyistä käsittelemään sähköpostihakemuksia.Henkilöstöliiga:Henkilöstöliiga on Etelä-Suomen vahvimpia henkilöstöpalveluyrityksiä ja työllistää vuosittain yli 1000 avainpelaajaa työelämän pelikentille! Työntekijöidemme joukosta löytyy teollisuuden, logistiikan- ja kiinteistöalan osaajia, sekä toimistotyön ja palvelualan työntekijöitä. Olemme Henkilöstöalan yritysten liiton (HELA) jäsenyritys ja toimimme reilusti työelämän yhteisten pelisääntöjen mukaan. Työntekijöiltämme saamme kiitosta tasa-arvoisesta ja ystävällisestä kohtelusta sekä aktiivisesta uusien työmahdollisuuksien tarjoamisesta.

title: Business Controller, Building and technical trade division, K Group
description: Business Controller, Kesko Building and technical trade divisionWould you like to work at the heart of one of Northern Europes leading building and technical trade businesses, supporting management decisions and driving profitable growth across eight countries? Our business operates in eight countries: Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Poland, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. Long-term profitability target for Kesko Building and technical trade is 6-8%.We are now looking for a Business Controller to join the Building and technical trade division Business Controlling team, which is responsible for all 8 countries. Your roleAs a Business Controller, you will work closely with businesses, finance teams in different business units and other finance functions at Kesko.Your role covers division business controlling activities including monthly reporting, profitability, investments, cash flow, working capital and market analysis. An important part of your role is various analyses that leads to concrete improvement actions. You will analyse business performance and its key drivers, assess profitability from different perspectives and look behind the numbers to understand what is driving the development. Based on your analysis, you will make clear actionable recommendations and drive actions to improve performance. In addition, you will take ownership of selected development projects such as customer, product or store profitability. Your key responsibilities include: - Monthly reporting including profitability analysis, benchmarking, analysis of key performance and profitability drivers and turning analysis into improvement actions - Cash flow and working capital analysis and driving actions to improve capital efficiency  - Market analysis and insight, including market development, market shares and benchmarking  - Taking ownership of selected development projects and driving change - Supporting planning and forecasting by turning historical performance and business drivers into forward-looking analysis and scenarios  - Developing reporting and analytics including the use of automation and AI together with other organizationsTo succeed in this role, we believe that youYou are analytical, curious and business-minded. You work efficiently also under tight deadlines and pressure. You are forward-looking and able to connect data, business drivers and market insights to identify opportunities and understand cause-and-effect relationships. You have the courage to challenge, bring forward new ideas and make clear and concrete recommendations and improvement actions. You are able to influence others and drive change across the organization.You work systematically and efficiently and can take ownership of development projects, bringing together data, business understanding and the right people to achieve concrete results. We expect you to... - Have a master's degree in finance, accounting, economics, industrial engineering and management or other relevant field. - Have several years of experience in business controlling, analytics, development or project management or another analytical finance role where you have worked closely with business stakeholders. - Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Have good communication and collaboration skills. - Be proactive and have a hands-on and development-oriented way of working. - Be fluent in Finnish and English, preferably also in Swedish.Experience in market analysis, investment analysis, cash flow management and reporting development is considered an advantage.Why join us?We offer you an opportunity to work at the centre of Keskos growing, international building and technical trade business and contribute to our profitable growth.You will gain a broad perspective of different businesses, countries and markets. You will work with questions that are relevant to business performance and decision-making, ranging from profitability, cash flow and growth opportunities to market development. The role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your business controlling and analytical expertise while working closely with experienced finance and business teams. We are proud of our positive work culture and can-do attitude! At Kesko, we work in a hybrid model combining office and remote work.In addition to an impactful role, we offer: - Modern office at Kalasatama, Helsinki with excellent public transportation, as well as parking facilities. Office services include gym, healthcare services, cafeteria and restaurant - Employee benefits that include: Epassi Flex, employee discounts at K Group stores, occupational health services and leisure-time accident insurance and possibility to a car benefit according to our company policy. Our partners also offer various benefits and discounts in the areas of sports and wellbeing, travel and optical services.Interested?The application period ends on 22.11.2026. For more information about the role, please contact Anna-Kaisa Tuovinen, Head of Business Control, Kesko Building and technical trade. Best times to reach out by phone are November 6 between 13:00-14:00 and November 16 between 14:00-15:00 (+358503030183). Please submit your application with your salary request via the apply link.The selected candidate will be subject to a credit check and drug testing in accordance with Kesko's recruitment and employment practices.We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. Equality, non-discrimination and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation and career development

title: Commissioning Coordinator - Thruster Systems
description: **Commissioning Coordinator - Thruster Systems**Are you interested in working with advanced propulsion solutions for the maritime market of today and tomorrow? An exciting opportunity has arisen for a **Commissioning Coordinator** within **Global Customer Support** Thrusters at Kongsberg Maritime.In this role, you will be part of the **Customer and Delivery Operations** function within the **Thruster Systems** business area. You will have technical and delivery responsibility for commissioning of thruster systems, acting as the main interface between customers, shipyards, site teams, field service engineers, and internal stakeholders.As Commissioning Coordinator, you will have single-point responsibility for the successful commissioning and delivery of Kongsberg Maritime thruster systems. From planning and coordination to technical support and customer handover, you will work closely with customers, shipyards, Field Service Engineers and project teams to deliver high-quality results on time._This is a great opportunity for either recent graduate or professional to join our Commissioning team!_**Key Responsibilities**- Single-point responsibility for planning, executing and delivering the complete thruster commissioning scope - Develop commissioning plans and manage execution schedules - Serve as the primary contact for customers, shipyards and internal stakeholders - Support and guide Field Service Engineers during commissioning - Review installations and give technical approval of thruster system installations - Ensure technical quality, documentation and final project delivery - Identify and manage risks, deviations and improvement opportunities **What we think you should have**- Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience - Experience with commissioning or technical project delivery - Strong technical understanding of complex mechanical, electrical or automation systems - Ability to plan, coordinate and drive technical activities independently - Customer-focused approach and strong communication skills - Fluent English, written and spoken - It is an advantage if you have: - Experience from the marine or offshore industry - Knowledge of thruster or propulsion systems **What We Can Offer You** With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, a good benefit package, flexible working hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with our remote work, you have the opportunity to work remotely for part of your working time. By choosing Kongsberg Maritime, you will work in an inspiring and safe work environment with sustainable and high-quality solutions for the future.**Work location** Rauma, Finland | Ulsteinvik, Norway or other KM locations in EMEA**Interested?** Please submit your application including your desired salary by 23rd of November through our recruitment system**Point of contact** For more information, please contact Juha Leppänen Team Leader, Control System Engineers juha.leppanen@km.kongsberg.com or Simon Sundal Commissioning Manager simon.sundal@km.kongsberg.com**Kongsberg Maritime** is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than **8,300** **employees in 35 countries.**Technologies for sustainable oceans**Our Global Customer Support** division is responsible for Kongsberg Maritimes services, upgrades and support in the aftermarket. Our 3400 employees are present in 35 different countries around the world. During the operational lifetime of more than 30.000 installations, we ensure cost-efficient delivery of services, upgrades and spare parts in order to secure availability and predictability to our customers.

title: Operatörer till INFICON Aaland Ab

title: Mekaaninen asentaja (Rauma)
description: Reilumpaa ja palkitsevampaa työnvälitystä! Vuonna 2018 perustetun yrityksemme tavoitteena on tarjota mielenkiintoisia työmahdollisuuksia Uudellamaalla sekä Varsinais-Suomessa. Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!TehtävänkuvausHaemme asiakkaallemme Raumalle mekaanista asentajaa pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Työtehtävääsi kuuluu koneiden kokoonpano ja laitteiden asennustehtävät. Työt alkavat 6 kuukauden määräaikaisuudella, jonka jälkeen sopivalle työntekijälle tarjotaan vakituista paikkaa. Töitä tehdään arkipäivisin päivävuorossa klo 8-16. Työtä tehdään 37,5h/vk. Jos haluat päästä työskentelemään osana ammattimaista työporukkaa, niin hae mukaan!Toivomme sinultaSinulla on työhön soveltuva koulutus (esim. raskaan kaluston, autonasentajan tai metallialan), teknisten piirusten lukutaitoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta muutaman vuoden ajalta. Pärjäät työssäsi itsenäisesti ja työnjälkesi on laadukasta. Olet innokas ja sinulta löytyy motivaatiota. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat kantaa vastuuta. Monipuolinen alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi sekä kaikenlainen koneasennuksen ja hydrauliikan tuntemus sekä autopuolen harrastuneisuus. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.Tarjoamme sinulleTarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa.Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Hae heti klikkaamalla painiketta "Hae työpaikkaa". Muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi). Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!Contio HenkilöstöpalvelutSähköposti: joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi Sijainti: Rauma

title: Personalkonsult till Barona i Vasa
description: Tycker du om att arbeta med människor, skapa goda relationer och hitta lösningar? Trivs du i en varierande arbetsvardag där du får ta ansvar, arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med andra? Då kan du vara den kollega vi söker!Vi söker nu en personalkonsult till vårt team i Vasa. I rollen arbetar du främst med våra industrikunder i Österbotten och har en viktig uppgift i att sammanföra rätt människor med rätt arbetsplatser. Vi söker dig som kan kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift, och som trivs i en roll med mycket kontakt med människor.Som personalkonsult får du ett mångsidigt arbete där rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du har nära kontakt med både våra kundföretag och medarbetare och bidrar till att samarbetet fungerar smidigt från rekrytering till avslutad anställning.Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi hjälper varandra och arbetar tillsammans för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Arbetsdagarna är varierande och tempot kan tidvis vara högt, men det är också det som gör arbetet intressant.Vad innebär arbetet?Som personalkonsult är du en viktig kontaktperson för våra kundföretag, arbetssökande och uthyrda medarbetare. Du ansvarar för rekryteringsprocesser och ser till att våra medarbetare får det stöd de behöver under sin anställning.Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:- Planering och genomförande av rekryteringar från början till slut.- Utformning och publicering av platsannonser samt hantering och bedömning av ansökningar.- Intervjuer och löpande kontakt med arbetssökande.- Aktiv kontakt med våra kundföretag, uppföljning av deras personalbehov och utveckling av kundrelationerna.- Löpande kontakt och stöd till våra uthyrda medarbetare via telefon, e-post och personliga möten.- Hantering av personalrelaterade ärenden under hela anställningens livscykel.- Identifiering av nya kundbehov och samarbetsmöjligheter.Arbetet innebär många kontakter och varierande situationer. Därför är det viktigt att du kan organisera din arbetsdag, prioritera mellan olika uppgifter och ta initiativ när det behövs.Du arbetar självständigt med dina ansvarsområden, men har alltid stöd av dina kollegor och Baronas övriga experter.Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med människor och har ett genuint intresse för rekrytering, personalfrågor och kundrelationer.Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt med olika människor och förstår vikten av god service och tydlig kommunikation. Du är ansvarstagande, noggrann och har förmågan att hålla ordning på flera uppgifter samtidigt.Vi uppskattar att du är initiativrik, flexibel och har en praktisk inställning till problemlösning. Vi värdesätter också din vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas i rollen.För att lyckas i rollen önskar vi att du har:- Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och finska, i tal och skrift.- God kommunikationsförmåga och lätt för att samarbeta med olika människor.- Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förmåga att arbeta självständigt.- Goda digitala färdigheter och lätt för att lära dig nya system.- Förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt.- Ett intresse för rekrytering, HR och kundarbete.Tidigare erfarenhet av rekrytering, HR, personalservice eller kundarbete är meriterande. Även erfarenhet från industrin eller kännedom om det österbottniska näringslivet ser vi som en fördel.Eftersom vi arbetar med människor med olika språklig och kulturell bakgrund är kunskaper i engelska också värdefulla.För oss är din inställning, samarbetsförmåga och vilja att utvecklas minst lika viktiga som din tidigare erfarenhet.Vad erbjuder vi dig?Hos Barona får du ett varierande arbete med möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka hur arbetet görs. Du får arbeta nära både människor och företag och vara en del av ett team där vi värdesätter samarbete, ansvar och en god arbetsgemenskap.Vi erbjuder dig:- Ett mångsidigt och ansvarsfullt arbete med varierande arbetsuppgifter.- Ett engagerat och hjälpsamt team där vi stöttar varandra.- En introduktion till arbetet och stöd från erfarna kollegor.- Möjlighet att utveckla både din egen kompetens och våra arbetssätt.- Frihet och ansvar i det dagliga arbetet.- Flexibla arbetstider, med arbetet huvudsakligen förlagt till dagtid.- En månadslön på 2 500-3 000 euro, beroende på din erfarenhet och kompetens.Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är Baronas kontor på Rostensgatan 1, 65100 Vasa.Barona som arbetsgivareBarona är ett finländskt arbetslivsföretag som hjälper människor och företag att hitta nya möjligheter i arbetslivet. Vi erbjuder tjänster inom bland annat rekrytering, personalservice och utveckling av arbetslivet.Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i ett stort företag med bred kompetens och många olika verksamhetsområden, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett lokalt team med nära samarbete.Vår arbetskultur bygger på frihet, ansvar, mod och att göra saker tillsammans. Vi tror på att ge människor förtroende, uppmuntra till utveckling och hjälpa varandra att lyckas.Vill du bli vår nya kollega?Låter det här som ett arbete som skulle passa dig? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Skicka in din ansökan via vårt ansökningsformulär och berätta gärna lite om dig själv och varför du är intresserad av tjänsten.Vi behandlar ansökningar och träffar kandidater redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Observera att vi av datasäkerhetsskäl endast behandlar ansökningar som skickas via ansökningsformuläret, inte per e-post.Mer information om tjänsten:Kristoffer WörlundOmrådeschef och ansvarig för rekryteringen0505200200
