title: Software Engineer
description: Job DescriptionHej Software Engineer, Do you want to help shape the digital future of IKEA? With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to ask questions, share your ideas, learn from mistakes and grow together with others. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have opportunities to try things you haven’t done before, while contributing to digital solutions that support how IKEA brings products to life and creates a better everyday life for the many people. We are on a journey to modernize our landscape, and we are looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems together with others to join the Digital Product Area ‘Range Core - Requirements and Compliance’ within Technology at Inter IKEA, Range Operations. Here you will help develop digital solutions that support product development, manufacturing, suppliers and the movement of IKEA products through our global value chain.  We believe good software is created by teams where people bring different perspectives, share knowledge, ask questions and learn together. You don’t need to know everything from day one. Curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to keep learning matter to us. We are growing our team in Malmö and looking for someone who enjoys working with people across different roles, teams, cultures and locations. QualificationsYour new job We’re looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems and learning together with others. Your strengths might be in frontend or backend development, or somewhere in between. What matters to us is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in growing and contributing across the stack. You’ll join a cross-functional team building and maintaining digital products across the stack, from backend services, APIs, integrations and databases to web applications and user experiences. You’ll have opportunities to build on your strengths while developing your skills in other areas. Together, we experiment, share knowledge and continuously improve how we design, build, test and deliver software. Your work will have a global impact, helping co-workers, suppliers, and partners collaborate effectively and ensuring trusted IKEA products reach our customers. What we’d like you to bring to the table     Experience building software solutions, with strengths in frontend, backend, or across the full stack.      Experience with backend development using C#/.NET and REST APIs and/or frontend development using React, TypeScript or similar technologies.      A good understanding of software design, data modelling, relational databases and building reliable, maintainable solutions.      An ability to understand complex problems, break them down into manageable parts and work with others to find practical solutions.     Experience with software testing and modern development practices, such as version control, continuous integration and automated delivery.      Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure, GCP or AWS is valuable, but not essential.      A collaborative mindset, curiosity and an interest in learning, sharing knowledge and improving together with your team.      An interest in understanding the wider product and contributing beyond your main area of expertise. Additional InformationBe yourself, a Software Engineer, and more! Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career. We welcome your application Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 19th of November. Apply by submitting your CV. As part of the application process, you will be asked to answer a few screening questions. When answering the questions, please avoid relying on AI-generated responses.  This position is based in Malmö, Sweden. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.  Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter Monaka Perumal; monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com. We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in Core Business Range and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB provided competence requirements are met for the role.

title: Music Creative Lead
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description: What you'll do As Music Creative Lead, you will define and evolve H&M's sonic identity, ensuring music strengthens brand expression, cultural relevance and customer engagement across every touchpoint. You will translate creative vision into music direction that elevates storytelling, shapes memorable brand experiences and connects H&M to culture through sound, artists and creative collaborations. In this role, you will:     Define and own H&M's sonic identity across consumer touchpoints, ensuring music consistently reinforces brand expression and cultural relevance.     Translate creative vision into clear music direction across content streams, events, in-store experiences and other key brand touchpoints.     Guide music and artist selection across production tiers, from Tier 1 campaigns to scalable content, ensuring consistency and creative excellence.     Partner closely with content, creative and PR teams to ensure music choices, artist collaborations and cultural moments strengthen creative concepts and audience resonance.     Provide creative direction to agencies and external partners on music selection, playlists, artists and sound references in line with overall brand and creative direction.     Identify opportunities where music, artists and culture can amplify H&M's brand positioning, storytelling and customer engagement.     Collaborate closely with the Music Operations & Partnerships Lead to ensure music direction is effectively delivered through the right partnerships, licensing solutions and operational frameworks.     Develop music frameworks, references and creative guidelines that support teams in making consistent and brand-aligned decisions.     Stay ahead of music trends, creator culture, emerging artists and platform developments to keep H&M's sonic expression current and forward-looking.     Champion innovative approaches to music and sound that enhance customer experiences across physical and digital channels. Who you'll work with You will be part of Creative Direction team and work closely with the Creative Director, Art Directors, Creative Strategists, PR teams, content creators, producers, agencies and external music partners. Together, you will create culturally relevant experiences that connect fashion, music and storytelling across global audiences. Who you are We are looking for people with:     Extensive experience within the music industry, combined with a strong understanding of fashion, culture and brand-building.     Proven experience shaping music direction for large-scale productions, campaigns or brand experiences.     Deep understanding of how music supports storytelling, emotional connection and brand expression.     Strong awareness of artists, music scenes, cultural movements and emerging trends across global markets.     Experience curating sound references, playlists and artist recommendations that elevate creative concepts.     Strong ability to translate creative direction into clear music briefs and actionable recommendations for agencies and external partners.     Experience collaborating across creative, content and production organisations.     Understanding of music licensing, sync rights and music usage considerations, enabling effective collaboration with operational and partnership teams.     Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. And people who are:     Passionate about music, culture and creativity.     Naturally curious and highly connected to emerging cultural movements.     Strategic thinkers who can balance creative ambition with business objectives.     Collaborative and skilled at building strong relationships across creative disciplines.     Comfortable operating between high-level creative direction and practical execution.     Forward-thinking and constantly exploring new ways music can strengthen customer engagement and brand relevance. Who we are H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  Why you'll love working here At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities around the globe. This is an opportunity to define the sound of one of the world's leading fashion brands. You'll work where fashion, culture, artists and creativity intersect, shaping how H&M connects with customers through music-driven storytelling and culturally relevant experiences around the world. Join us Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it's our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer needed!
description: About the positionPerido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.Your daily tasksIn this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers, and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a separate final step.Key Responsibilities:    Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks    Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance    Test data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, and data transformations across GCP    Validate rule-based detection engines and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention    Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems    Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing    Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows    Ensure AI-generated test assets and results are appropriately reviewed, validated, traceable, and reproducible    Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them    Promote good testing practices and support the wider team in continuously improving quality engineeringYour characteristicsWe are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking initiative, solving complex problems and working independently, while also enjoying close collaboration with others. You have a structured approach to your work and the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to different stakeholders.Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!Please submit your application for this role in English.Qualifications:    8–10+ years of relevant experience in test automation, technical testing, quality engineering, or testing of complex software systems    Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks    Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, together with good SQL knowledge    Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic testing, including the use of AI or agents within the software testing lifecycle    Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, preferably including technologies such as BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer    Strong experience in data, ETL, and data quality testing    Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic    Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, CI/CD, and end-to-end testing    Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships between data, technology, business requirements, and controls    A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively in a cross-functional agile team    Strong communication and documentation skills    A B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent relevant education and professional experience Advantageous:    Experience within banking, Financial Crime Prevention, transaction monitoring, compliance, or another regulated environment    Experience applying AI-enabled development or testing tools in professional software engineering    ISTQB or similar testing certification    Google Cloud certification    Requirements Engineering certification, such as REQB or equivalentContract type and hoursFull-time consulting assignment until 2027-12-31. title: Sourcing Manager IT
description: Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. title: Planner & Scheduler
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.Employment: Temporary, 12-24 monthsLocation: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Planner & Scheduler for our Planning & Scheduling team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support planning and scheduling activities for an assigned project area.As Planner & Scheduler, you will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, Project Controls, EPCM partners, and contractors to maintain realistic and integrated schedules. You will help track progress, identify constraints and schedule risks, and provide reliable planning information to support project execution and decision-making.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Develop, update, and maintain project schedules in line with project planning standards    Support the maintenance and integration of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for your assigned area    Review EPCM and contractor schedules and identify inconsistencies, missing logic, constraints, and potential impacts    Integrate schedule information from contractors, EPCM partners, and internal stakeholders    Monitor actual progress against planned activities and support schedule updates and forecasting    Analyze schedules to identify delays, trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities    Support mitigation and recovery planning when schedule challenges arise    Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, planning workshops, and weekly and monthly reportingWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    3+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling or similar roles, preferably within industrial, construction, infrastructure, or EPCM projects    Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Project Controls, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience    Good understanding of project planning and scheduling methodologies    Experience developing, updating, and analyzing project schedules    Understanding of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), schedule integration, progress measurement, and forecasting    Ability to review contractor and EPCM schedules and identify constraints, risks, and inconsistencies    Experience using relevant planning and scheduling tools    Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with fluency in EnglishBenefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden SiteOur Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden Video

title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description: TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.What we’re looking for    Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.    A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.    Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.    Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.    Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.    Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.    A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.What you’ll do    Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.    Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.    Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.    Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.    Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.    Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.    Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.    Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.About your applicationPlease submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: OT Cyber Security Engineer
description: OT Cyber Security Engineer – Substation AutomationKey Responsibilities:1. Security Audits    Identify vulnerabilities in IEC 61850-based communication, RTUs, IEDs, and SCADA networks.    Assist to perform penetration testing and red teaming for substation control environments.    Perform technical audits of SCADA devices and networks, and any other connected networks, to identify security concerns.    Evaluate security compliance with NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and IEEE standards.    Support Global Projects by adapting HVDC Cyber security for SCADA & HMI.2. Security Implementation & Architecture    Design and implement segmented network architectures for substations (firewalls, DMZs, VLANs).    Secure IEC 61850 protocols (GOOSE, MMS, SMV) to prevent cyber-attacks.    Deploy Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and Endpoint Protection for OT environments.    Harden SCADA servers, HMIs, and substation gateways against cyber threats.    Develop architecture & functional descriptions for Functions / Solutions for future HVDC in cyber security technologies.    Evaluate and strengthen the security of any connections to the SCADA network.    Monitor and Validate third party security patches to ensure that reliability of the system is maintained.    Implement the security features provided by device and system vendors.3. Incident Response & Threat Management    Develop and test Incident Response Plans (IRP) for cyber events in substations.    Monitor threat intelligence and assess the impact of cyber threats on energy transmission systems.    Assist in forensic investigations of cybersecurity incidents in substations.    Implement Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and role-based access control (RBAC) in substation networks.4. Compliance & Regulatory Alignment    Ensure compliance with NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) for bulk electric systems.    Align cybersecurity controls with IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and IEEE 1686.    Assist in audit preparation and regulatory reporting for utilities and power grid operators.5. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement    Work with utility companies, regulators, and vendors to enhance grid cybersecurity.    Participate in industry working groups (NERC, IEEE, ISA, EPRI) to influence cybersecurity standards.    Support projects in resolving the issues related to Cyber security Functions. Required Skills :Technical Skills    Deep understanding of substation automation (IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, MMS, GOOSE messaging).    SCADA, RTU, IED, and EMS security expertise.    Network security (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, NAC) in OT environments.    Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of OT/ICS systems.    Experience with SIEM, log management, and anomaly detection tools.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Kentix is on a mission to establish KentixONE as a leading operating system for physical IT security. Our focus is mission-critical IT environments, from individual racks and distributed IT rooms to modular data centers and white-space environments.As part of ASSA ABLOY, we are now expanding into the Swedish market.We are looking for an entrepreneurial Business Development Manager who wants to do more than sell products. You'll develop and drive our go-to-market strategy for Sweden. As the face of Kentix in the Swedish market, you'll build relationships with end customers and partners, create new business opportunities and help establish Kentix as a recognized provider of physical IT security solutions.What you'll work on    Drive the commercial growth of Kentix in Sweden, taking ownership of market development and helping establish Kentix as a trusted partner for physical IT security.    Identify, engage and win new business opportunities with end customers operating mission-critical IT environments, including data centers, critical infrastructure and enterprise IT organizations.    Expand the Kentix ecosystem by collaborating with partners, consultants, system integrators and other key stakeholders across the Swedish market.    Act as the local Kentix expert and pre-sales consultant, supporting ASSA ABLOY sales teams with customer opportunities, solution specifications and the successful positioning of KentixONE.What will help you succeed    Experience in Business Development, solution sales or market development within data centers, IT infrastructure, critical infrastructure, physical security, networking, power infrastructure or related technology sectors.    An established network within the Swedish market and the ability to leverage relationships to create commercial opportunities.    Experience selling complex technical solutions to enterprise customers through direct and partner-led channels.    Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage confidently with both technical and commercial stakeholders.    Fluent Swedish and English communication skills and willingness to travel across Sweden to meet customers and partners.Why KentixKentix combines physical security, access control and infrastructure monitoring in one integrated platform designed for mission-critical IT environments. As we expand in Sweden, you'll join at a pivotal stage of our growth journey. This is an opportunity to combine the agility of a growing business with the strength of ASSA ABLOY while helping customers protect mission-critical IT environments.    Meaningful Impact – Help organizations protect critical IT infrastructure and improve operational resilience in environments where reliability is essential.    Innovative Technology – Represent KentixONE, an integrated platform that brings together physical security, access control and monitoring capabilities in a single solution.    Entrepreneurial Freedom – Take ownership of a developing market and play a direct role in shaping our growth in Sweden.    International Collaboration – Work alongside experienced Business Development colleagues across Europe while benefiting from the strength and stability of ASSA ABLOY.    Flexible Working – Work where you're closest to customers, with the flexibility and autonomy needed to succeed in a market-facing role. Ready to build a market rather than inherit one?If you're excited by the opportunity to build a market, work with innovative technology and make a direct impact on Kentix's success in Sweden, we'd like to hear from you.Apply today and help us create a safer and more open world.We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. Just set up your profile and apply here. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner at lea.rein@assaabloy.comDepending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.We are the ASSA ABLOY GroupOur people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
description: Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADAAbout the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

title: Head of Digital – Retail to Lindex, Gothenburg
description: The opportunityThis is a broad digital leadership role with responsibility for the systems and capabilities that support Lindex entire retail network. You have the opportunity to influence both operational reliability and the future development of the retail area.The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You lead a multidisciplinary organisation that includes digital leads, developers and managers.About the roleAs Head of Digital – Retail, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across the company’s retail network. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through collaboration across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.The Head of Digital – Retail holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).Key responsibilities    Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for the retail area.    Ensure stable operations and continuous improvement of point-of-sale systems, RFID solutions, the employee retail app and security gate systems.    Identify opportunities to improve retail processes, including pricing, product handling and the establishment of new retails.    Monitor system performance and lead effective incident management for business-critical retail solutions.    Coordinate digital requirements with Facilities and Properties to secure connectivity, fibre infrastructure and appropriate technical retail formats.    Balance operational stability, incremental improvements and the development of new digital capabilities.    Lead a team of developers, digital leads and managers.    Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Manegement Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.    Collaborate across the organization to align retail priorities with Lindex overall business, digital and technology direction.    Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.About youYou understand the complexity of retail operations and recognise how even small changes in technology can have a significant operational impact. You combine curiosity about retail with sound judgement, structured prioritisation and the ability to turn business needs into workable digital solutions. You provide clarity across organisational boundaries and maintain a strong focus on stability, performance and continuous improvement.To succeed in the role, you need:    A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.    Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.    Extensive leadership experience, including leading managers, employees or cross-functional teams.    Experience translating business strategy and operational needs into digital priorities, capabilities and execution.    Experience leading digital products, platforms, data, automation, agile delivery, objectives and key results, and backlog prioritisation.    Experience driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.    Strong communication skills and fluency in English.It is an advantage if you have:    Experience from retail and a strong understanding of day-to-day retail operations.    Experience with point-of-sale systems, RFID technology, retail applications or other retail-related platforms.    Experience with monitoring, incident management and business-critical technical infrastructure.    Experience leading across reporting lines and building trust with business and digital stakeholders.    Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.Location and ApplicationThe position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. title: Produktspecialist - Underjordsutrustning
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Produktspecialist - Underjordsutrustning Följ med oss när vi accelererar transformationen! Som Produktspecialist – Underjordsutrustning hos Epiroc får du en nyckelroll i att stötta våra kunder och interna serviceteam med djup teknisk kompetens inom underjordsutrustning. Du är en senior teknisk rådgivare som bidrar till säkra, effektiva och hållbara lösningar — och gör verklig skillnad där det händer. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och stöttar varandra i vardagen, med målet att alltid leverera högsta kvalitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer. Hos oss är du en viktig representant för Epirocs varumärke och våra värderingar: Innovation, Samarbete och Engagemang. Ditt uppdrag I rollen som Produktspecialist arbetar du både strategiskt och operativt. Du är en central kompetensresurs som kombinerar tekniskt arbete i fält med rådgivning, utbildning och problemlösning. Ditt uppdrag innebär bland annat att: •    Agera senior teknisk rådgivare gentemot kunder och interna servicetekniker•    Utföra service, reparationer, felsökning och uppstarter av underjordsutrustning•    Genomföra praktiska utbildningar för nyanställda och kunder•    Säkerställa att arbete utförs säkert genom riskanalyser och efterlevnad av Epirocs regelverk•    Ha en löpande och proaktiv kunddialog genom hela arbetsprocessen•    Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och verksamhet•    Dokumentera arbeten, rapportera tid och material samt vid behov bistå med prisestimat Du arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor och har en viktig roll i att skapa förtroende och långsiktigt kundvärde. Din profilDu är en trygg, lösningsorienterad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll där du får ta ansvar och dela med dig av din kunskap. Säkerhet är en självklar del av ditt arbetssätt, och du har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera tydligt. Vi ser gärna att du har: •    Stark teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet av service och felsökning av underjords utrustning•    Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och samtidigt ge stöd och rådgivning i mer komplexa ärenden•    Ett strukturerat och kundfokuserat arbetssätt med god kommunikationsförmåga•    God förståelse i svenska och engelska Erfarenhet av utbildning, teknisk support eller arbete i kundnära miljö är meriterande. Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter. Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc: •    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus Placering och resorDenna tjänst är placerad i Slagsta. Resor förekommer främst i Stockholmsområdet, men det kan även förekomma resor till andra orter. Ansökan och kontaktinformationVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 29 november 2026: Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Payments
description: We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments team in Stockholm. We're a small team that owns everything that happens when someone pays Epidemic Sound: checkout, subscriptions, invoicing, refunds, tax, and payment provider integrations happens through systems we build and run. We work in short iterations where our changes bring immediate customer value.Our main initiative is a new purchase platform in Go: a greenfield subscription domain, built alongside today's system, including a seamless migration of live paying customers onto our new system. You'll help set and implement this technical direction.We’re a small and collaborative team that owns services end to end, from domain model to Terraform, on-call included. You'll work closely with Product, Finance, and the web teams whose checkout journeys sit on our APIs. AI is part of our daily toolchain, which puts more weight on judgement: we read as much code as we write.Your key responsibilities include    Own payment and subscription services end to end: design, build, deploy and monitor them.        Build the next generation of our purchase platform in Go, and move live subscriptions onto it safely.        Build and maintain our payment provider integrations, including the compliance-heavy parts like 3DS and SCA.        Work in the customer-facing purchase flow in our web codebase (TypeScript) when needed.Requirements    Several years building and running backend services in production, ideally in a space where correctness mattered more than shipping speed.        Strong in Go or Python, and happy to get productive in the other. Our services are built in both.        Good in SQL and relational data modelling. We use Postgres.        Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud, and comfortable owning your own infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform).        Enough TypeScript and React to make changes in a shared frontend codebase, or a real interest in picking it up.        Experience with payments, or a clear interest in it: subscriptions, billing, provider integrations, reconciliation, etc.It would also be music to our ears if you have    Migrated a billing or payment platform with live customers on it.        Worked with PSPs, card networks, 3DS and SCA, or inside PCI scope.        Experience building event-driven services using Pub/Sub or a comparable messaging system.        Practical experience applying AI coding agents in production, and sound judgement about when to rely on them.

title: Inventory Planner
description: Company DescriptionIn Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers. We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people. Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability. Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets. IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen. About the role  We are now looking for an Inventory Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy supports availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move safely, reliably and efficiently from supplier to distribution centre and onwards into the IKEA Food experience. The role works closely with Category, suppliers, service providers, distribution centres and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, forecasts, lead times and distribution to take clear inventory actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value. In this role you will:     Own supplier-to-DC and/or DC-DC inbound availability for assigned products, DCs and markets.     Maintain accurate inventory and inbound flow execution, including orders, ERP corrections and physical-flow corrections.     Act on daily inventory corrections, inbound order handling, flow bookings and deviations within agreed parameters.     Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and lead-time adherence when planning and following up the inbound flow.     Secure supplier and logistics-service-provider execution through confirmations, holiday planning, inbound coordination and invoice follow-up.     Manage deviations related to quality, blocked goods, shelf life, shortages and inventory accuracy with timely action and escalation.     Improve ways of working together with suppliers, service providers, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders. We are looking for someone who:     Has experience from supply-chain operations, inventory-, supply planning, inbound logistics or DC flow.     Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management and planning systems.     Uses operational KPIs, inventory data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.     Understands availability at lowest cost, freshness, quality and inventory-accuracy risks, and knows when to act or escalate.     Communicates well across suppliers, logistics service providers and internal teams.     Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the inbound goods flow reliable every day. Reliable availability depends on many small inventory and inbound flow decisions done right, every day. As Inventory Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, compliance, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn supplier, inventory and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets. As part of your application, we ask you to rank the Food roles you apply for in order of preference. This helps us better understand your aspirations and supports a fair and efficient matching process across opportunities.For questions about the role, please contact Business Development Managers Irina Kärnsund via, irina.karnsund@inter.ikea.comWe look forward to receiving your application by the 17th of November, 2026.If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process contact People & Culture Specialists Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Licensed Veterinarian to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital

title: Strategic Product Manager | Early Career Program
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   About this opportunity   Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research & Development, Market Area, and Product Management contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. This isn’t a program where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. Your journey within the Innovate Program will start as Strategic Product Manager.     What you will do   Would you like to build on your technical experience and explore how technology turns into products, customer value and new business opportunities? In this role, you will join our RAN Software Product Management team, working with new service capabilities and security in RAN. You will learn how we shape our portfolio, understand emerging market and customer needs for 5G and 6G, and translate technology into clear value for our customers. We are looking for an early-career professional who wants to build on a strong technical foundation and grow towards strategic product management. You will work alongside experienced Strategic Product Managers and gain exposure to both the technical, marketing and commercial sides of RAN Software. Your initial focus will be on Differentiated Connectivity, supporting work around new connectivity capabilities and services, including network slicing, service awareness and time critical applications.      Work alongside Strategic Product Managers to support the development of our RAN Software portfolio.     Explore how advanced RAN and 5G capabilities can address customer needs and enable new services and business opportunities     Develop stories and proof points that helps our presales and sales teams globally to translate technical capabilities into clear value propositions and customer benefits     Support customer engagements together with product managers, Market Areas and other teams across Ericsson     Analyse market developments, customer needs and emerging services to provide relevant insights to the team     Build your understanding of RAN Software product management, while gaining exposure to our broader portfolio.      You will bring        2–5 years of relevant professional experience, ideally within RAN, telecom technology, systems engineering, research, technical presales or a related area     A strong technical foundation and understanding of mobile networks, ideally with experience or knowledge of RAN     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand new and complex topics quickly     The ability to communicate technical topics clearly and work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders     Curiosity about customers, markets and the business opportunities created by new technology     A collaborative mindset and the ability to build relationships across different teams and areas     Strong personal drive, accountability and a willingness to learn and take on new challenges

title: Client Service Specialist
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Client Service Specialist--- Client Service Specialist=========================ResponsibilitiesAon plc (NYSE:AON) is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement and health solutions. Our 60'000 colleagues in 120 countries empower results for clients by using proprietary data and analytics to deliver insights that reduce volatility and improve performance.In Switzerland, Aon includes Aon Reinsurance, Aon Wealth Solutions and Aon Commercial Risk Solutions, Health \& Affinity with around 380 employees in Basel, Geneva, Locarno, Neuchâtel, Nyon, Wollerau, Zug and Zurich. To strengthen our Operations team in Zurich we are looking for an enthusiastic, highly motivated, and curious:**Client Service Specialist (80 \- 100%)****About the team**The In Field Operations (IFO) team sits at the heart of Aon's Commercial Risk Solutions business. We provide a centralized support structure that standardizes operations and reduces manual work across teams. By doing so, we free colleagues to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional service and value to our clients. Alongside day\-to\-day operations, the team drives digitalization and automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency across the business.**The role**We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Client Service Specialist** to join the IFO team in Zurich. This is a high\-volume, execution\-focused role where consistency, accuracy and a can\-do attitude are key. You will take ownership of a large workload of structured, process\-driven tasks, ensuring that policy and master data are correct and up to date. If you take pride in doing things right, work well independently and don't shy away from repetitive work, this role is for you.**Key Responsibilities:*** Independently process insurance policy onboardings, offboardings and mutations accurately and on time* Handle high volumes of structured, recurring operational tasks with care and consistency* Identify and flag data inconsistencies, process gaps, or recurring issues to the team leader and colleagues, and help drive their resolution.* Collaborate with team members to document processes and workflows, ensuring they are clear and kept up to date, and support the onboarding of new colleagues.* Contribute to continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives by providing feedback and ideas from day\-to\-day operations.* Live a culture of operational excellence through thorough, precise execution and a strong sense of ownership.**Requirements:*** Completed commercial apprenticeship* A few years of experience in an operational, administrative or data entry role, ideally in an insurance environment* Strong attention to detail and a structured, methodical way of working* Comfortable handling high workloads and repetitive tasks without compromising quality* Reliable, self\-organized and able to work independently* Proficient in Microsoft Office; comfortable picking up new systems quickly* Fluent in English, is strongly preferred, French nice to have* A positive attitude and genuine willingness to roll up your sleeves and get things done**Why Aon:*** Aon offers a dynamic and flexible work environment* Valuable exposure to professional growth and development opportunities* A commitment to diversity, equality, and inclusion* Access to a global network of colleagues and resources* A culture of innovation and continuous improvementAt Aon, we provide equal opportunity to all employees and job seekers, regardless of gender,ethnicity, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, etc. Aon iscommitted to a diverse workforce and is an affirmative action employer. We drive and promote inclusiveness, building an environment where everyone has opportunities for growth and development.We would like to draw your attention to the fact that we are looking for a person whose profile corresponds to the requirements mentioned in the advertisement. We will therefore only respond to applicants who meet these criteria.Please only apply online via our application tool.![Aon Schweiz AG]()* Aon Schweiz AG  Vulkanstrasse 106  8048 Zürich*jid2efecd3jm jit1145jm jiy26jm

title: Regional Fundraising Delegate Südasien
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Regional Fundraising Delegate Südasien--- Regional Fundraising Delegate Südasien=======================================Finanzielle Nachhaltigkeit wird für die Rotkreuz\- und Rothalbmondgesellschaften (RKRH) im asiatisch\-pazifischen Raum (APAC) zunehmend wichtiger. Da internationale Fördermittel abnehmen, humanitäre Bedürfnisse jedoch zunehmen, bauen die nationalen Gesellschaften ihre Mittelbeschaffung durch lokale private Geldgeber aus. Um sie dabei zu unterstützen, sucht das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) **per 1\. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung** eine:n Regional Fundraising Delegate für Südasien. Die Tätigkeit umfasst die fachliche Beratung und praktische Unterstützung der nationalen Schwestergesellschaften des SRK, insb. in Bangladesch und Nepal, beim Aufbau nachhaltiger Fundraising\-Systeme Bangladesch und des Kreuzes in Nepal bei der Entwicklung und Einführung nachhaltiger Fundraising\-Systeme, mit Fokus auf Mittelbeschaffung und Spenderbindung* Betreuung von Fundraising\-Teams in den der Projektberichterstattung und am Wissensaustausch innerhalb der Region### Das bringen Sie mit* Hochschulabschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation oder Fundraising mit mind. fünf Jahren nachgewiesener Erfahrung in der Mittelbeschaffung durch private Geldgeber in einer nicht gewinnorientierten Organisation* Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit mind. einem der folgenden On\- oder Offline\-Instrumente: Einzelspenden (Direktmarketing), Digital Fundraising (Spenderkommunikation, Spendenkampagnen), Face\-to\-Face\-Fundraising (Dauerspenden), Key\-Account\-Management für vermögende Privatpersonen oder unternehmen* Vertrautheit mit CRM\-Systemen für Fundraising\-Aktivitäten inkl. Einführung von Donor Journeys* Sicherheit im Projektmanagement mit multiplen Stakeholdern, Kommunikations\- und Koordinationsgeschick, Führungsqualitäten* Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Kenntnisse in Bengalisch oder Nepalesisch sind ein Vorteil* Berufserfahrung in der RKRH\-Bewegung sowie internationale Berufserfahrung in Südasien sind ein Vorteil### Das erwartet Sie bei uns* 12 Monate befristete Anstellung* Beiträge an Sozialversicherungen, Reise\- und Unterkunftskosten### So kommen Sie zu unsWir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Online\-Bewerbung bis zum 15\. title: AUTOMATIKER/IN EFZ
description: Securecell ist ein Schweizer Technologieunternehmen an der Schnittstelle von Biotechnologie, Ingenieurwesen und Gesundheitswesen. Seit mehr als drei Jahrzehnten entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen, die wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen voranbringen und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Durch die Kombination aus umfassender Expertise in der Bioprozesskontrolle und einer ausgeprägten Innovationskultur arbeiten wir interdisziplinär zusammen, um komplexe Herausforderungen in praktische Technologien zu verwandeln, die einen echten Mehrwert schaffen. Im Rahmen unseres nachhaltigen Innovations- und Wachstumskurses suchen wir eine/nAUTOMATIKER/IN EFZ für unser Manufacturing- und Supply-Chain-Team.DIE CHANCEDies ist mehr als nur ein Job. Es ist die Möglichkeit, zu Technologien beizutragen, die bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen unterstützen und die Zukunft der Biotechnologie und des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten. Als Mitglied unseres Manufacturing- und Supply-Chain-Teams spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Konzeption, Entwicklung, Verifizierung und dem Lebenszyklusmanagement von Automationslösungen für innovative Steuerungen, die in der Biopharmazie  eingesetzt werden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Expertinnen und Experten aus unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen wirken Sie an anspruchsvollen Projekten mit, entwickeln innovative Lösungen und tragen dazu bei, Produkte bereitzustellen, die für unsere Kunden weltweit Mehrwert schaffen. SPS-Programmierung).•    Vertrautheit mit elektrischen, mechanischen und pneumatischen Komponenten sowie mit industriellen Sensoren und Aktuatoren.•    Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, Schaltpläne und Dokumentationen zu lesen und zu interpretieren.WARUM SIE GERNE BEI SECURECELL ARBEITEN WERDENEinen Unterschied machen: Ihre Arbeit trägt zu innovativen Technologien bei, die wissenschaftlichen Fortschritt ermöglichen, die Gesundheitsversorgung verbessern und reale Herausforderungen lösen.Mit aussergewöhnlichen Menschen arbeiten: Werden Sie Teil eines globalen Teams aus talentierten Wissenschaftlern, Ingenieuren, Softwareentwicklern und Business-Professionals, die Innovation und Zusammenarbeit leben.Ihre Karriere weiterentwickeln: Wir fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und bieten Möglichkeiten, neue Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, Ihr Fachwissen auszubauen und neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen.Jeden Tag innovativ sein: Arbeiten Sie an modernsten Projekten mit und helfen Sie dabei, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Grenzen von Biotechnologie, Automatisierung und Medizintechnologie erweitern.Verantwortung übernehmen: Wir glauben, dass grossartige Ideen von überall kommen können. B. description: La Fédération des Hôpitaux Vaudois informatique (FHVi), est le partenaire informatique privilégié de plus de 12 Hôpitaux et établissements de santé régionaux du canton de Vaud. Ce sont plus de 100 collaborateurs au service de 10'000 utilisateurs, pour parc de plus de 7'000 postes de travail répartis sur une centaine de sites géographiques et sur trois cantons (VD, VS, FR).Le poste s'adresse indifféremment à une femme ou à un homme. A des fins de commodité de lecture, les termes ne sont qu'au masculin.**Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico\-fonctionnelle**  Et si votre expertise technique et votre autonomie dans la résolution de problématiques applicatives complexes.Ce poste s'adresse à un professionnel expérimenté qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement des applications dans leur globalité, performance, leur sécurité et leur évolution.Véritable référent technico\-fonctionnel, vous intervenez aussi bien sur la résolution d'incidents complexes que sur l'analyse des besoins métier, les évolutions applicatives et les études de faisabilité.Vous êtes capable de passer d'une problématique fonctionnelle à une investigation technique approfondie, puis à la définition et à la mise en œuvre d'une solution adaptée.Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs des établissements hospitaliers, les équipes informatiques internes et les fournisseurs de solutions.Votre rôle repose sur un équilibre entre expertise opérationnelle, compréhension métier, autonomie technique et capacité à prendre du recul sur les solutions proposées.**Vos principales activités et responsabilité :****Gestion applicative et résolution d'incidents complexes*** Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnelle des applications de votre périmètre et garantir leur disponibilité, leur performance et leur fiabilité.* Prendre en charge les incidents applicatifs complexes nécessitant une analyse approfondie des dimensions fonctionnelles et techniques.* Investiguer les dysfonctionnements de manière autonome, identifier leurs causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des solutions correctives durables.* Analyser les interactions et dépendances entre applications, bases de données, serveurs, interfaces et composants techniques.* Exploiter les bases de données, notamment au travers de requêtes SQL avancées, pour analyser les anomalies et identifier les actions correctives.* Réaliser les premières investigations techniques et solliciter les expertises spécialisées lorsque la situation le nécessite.* Anticiper les risques liés aux évolutions technologiques, aux incompatibilités et à l'obsolescence des composants applicatifs.**Expertise technique et intégration des systèmes*** Comprendre les architectures applicatives et les mécanismes d'intégration entre systèmes hétérogènes.* Analyser les échanges de données, les interfaces et les webservices afin d'identifier et de résoudre les problèmes d'interopérabilité.* Lire, comprendre et analyser du code existant, notamment en environnement C\#/.NET, afin de faciliter les investigations et les évolutions applicatives.* Exploiter et adapter des scripts, notamment PowerShell, pour automatiser certaines opérations ou contribuer à la résolution de problèmes.* Intervenir sur les problématiques liées aux environnements applicatifs Windows, aux bases de données et aux dépendances techniques.* Collaborer avec les équipes de développement, d'infrastructure et d'interopérabilité pour assurer la cohérence et la maintenabilité des solutions.**Évolution des applications et analyse des besoins métier*** vie fiable et sécurisé. \*\*Missions principales\*\* \* Vous réalisez les travaux d'entretien des locaux et des bâtiments, ainsi que le suivi du bon fonctionnement des installations \* Vous participez de base des équipements et des véhicules \* Vous prenez part aux tâches hivernales (déneigement, salage) ainsi qu'au service de piquet selon le planning \* Vous veillez au respect des normes de title: Quality Assurance Inspector (m/f/d/x)
description: Let’s bring quality, safety, and sustainability to life together!Intertek makes our world a little better every day! A job at Intertek offers a great opportunity to work alongside 46,000 colleagues worldwide to continuously improve the safety, quality, and sustainability of products. Through our services, we support our clients across a wide range of industries in more than 1,000 laboratories worldwide.Intertek Government and Trade Services helps governments, customs authorities, and standards organizations ensure that imported goods meet international safety and quality standards. We help protect the public and the environment from non-compliant products, secure import duties, and ensure smooth customs clearance and international trade.For a position in German-speaking Switzerland, We are seeking a Quality Assurance Inspector (m/f/d/x) to join our team as soon as possible on a 20–40% basis. The position is offered on a self-employed, independent contractor basis with compensation at an hourly rate.Your Responsibilities-Conducting visual quality inspections of goods, materials, and shipments to identify defects, damage, or deviations-Taking product samples in accordance with specified inspection requirements-Verifying quantities, batches, and piece counts based on the provided documentation-Documenting inspection results using specified checklists and creating comprehensive photographic documentation-Conducting inspections at suppliers’, customers’, or transit locations within the assigned region-Ensuring compliance with internal quality, safety, and inspection standardsYour Profile-Education or degree in a science-related field (e.g., chemistry, biology, or a comparable discipline)-Valid driver’s license and willingness to undertake regular regional business trips-Excellent written and spoken German and English skills-Good IT user skills-Strong observational skills, high attention to detail, and an independent and structured approach to work-High commitment to quality, a strong sense of responsibility, and integrityYour Benefits-Our open corporate culture with flat hierarchies offers plenty of room for your ideas-You’ll work in a dynamic team as part of an international company-With flexible flex time, annual work hours, we prioritize work-life balance and the ability to balance family -and career-We are committed to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity-We value differences, actively promote inclusion, and create an environment that fosters each person’s individuality in the best interest of the company.Interested and motivated?Then please submit your detailed application materials online, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations!

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux - solutions B2B--- Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux \- solutions B2B=====================================================Chez ello, notre vision est de faire du monde digital une expérience humaine. Connecter est notre métier. Notre secteur d’activité, les télécommunications, nous plonge dans un univers stimulant où se construisent les technologies du futur. Nous sommes le fournisseur de connectivité leader de Neuchâtel et partenaire de Sunrise. Au cœur du digital, notre objectif est clair : offrir une expérience clientèle incomparable. Rejoins notre équipe en tant que : **Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux – solutions B2B**Avant\-vente, projets et support **Tes missions**Tu aimes autant comprendre les besoins d’un client que résoudre un problème technique ? Chez ello, tu combines infrastructure IT, applications métiers et accompagnement des entreprises.* Tu participes à l’avant\-vente B2B : analyse des besoins, présentation des solutions et contribution au chiffrage.* Tu pilotes les projets techniques confiés et accompagnes les clients de la mise en service au support.* Tu secondes le responsable qualité dans la maintenance des applications métiers et les tests des mises à jour.* Tu exploites notre IT interne et assures sa sécurité, sa disponibilité et le support aux utilisateur·trices.* Tu participes au piquet de niveau 1 pour les réseaux backbone et HFC et les clients B2B sous contrat 24/7 : diagnostic, orientation des tickets et premiers dépannages réseau autorisés. **Ton profil et ta personnalité*** Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en administration et exploitation d’infrastructures : Windows/Linux, virtualisation, stockage et postes de travail.* Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux réseau (TCP/IP, VLAN, routage, DNS/DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi, pare\-feu), la configuration des équipements et le diagnostic des incidents.* Tu sais sécuriser les accès et assurer les mises à jour, la supervision, les sauvegardes et la restauration des services.* Tu comprends les applications métiers et les services web et de messagerie, avec des bases en SQL et en scripts.* Autonome et méthodique, tu sais prioriser, documenter et escalader. À l’aise avec les clients, tu aimes expliquer la technique et souhaites t’impliquer dans l’avant\-vente et les projets B2B.* Cisco CCNA ou compétences équivalentes souhaitées. Des connaissances Cisco/Meraki et M\-Files sont des atouts.* Tu aimes apprendre et élargir tes compétences. Ouvert·e aux nouvelles approches, tu partages tes idées et proposes des améliorations concrètes. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre :**Chez ello, nous évoluons dans un secteur essentiel. Notre réseau fait fonctionner les entreprises, soigner les hôpitaux, enseigner les écoles et connecte chacun à ses proches. Employeur moderne et certifié « Great Place to Work », nous créons un environnement de travail basé sur la confiance et la responsabilisation. Travailler chez ello, c’est incarner notre mentalité basée sur la fiabilité, la détermination, l’ouverture, l’accessibilité et l’empathie. Nous sommes une PME où la polyvalence est essentielle : pas de routine, mais des défis variés et une vraie marge de manœuvre. Tu travailleras dans nos bureaux avec une vue imprenable sur le lac de Neuchâtel. Tu pourras te changer les idées dans notre salle de repos et profiter de la possibilité de faire du télétravail et du remote office. Nous aimons passer du temps ensemble, c’est pour cela que notre comité festif organise des événements mensuels. **Ta postulation :**Si notre offre d’emploi a éveillé ton intérêt, nous t’invitons à nous transmettre ton dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail et diplômes/attestations) sur le site   . Nous nous engageons à te donner une réponse qu’elle amène à une rencontre ou à un remerciement de nous avoir considéré comme employeur. Par ailleurs, sois assuré·e que nous accordons une importance primordiale à garantir un processus de recrutement juste et équitable. Notre démarche de recrutement est simple, transparente et orientée vers l’échange : notre objectif est de mieux nous connaître pour envisager une collaboration qui a du sens pour toi comme pour nous.![ello communications S.A.]()* ello communications S.A.  Av. \- 20  2000 Neuchâtel*jid3391ad7jm jit1145jm jiy26jm
